set.body: Establish a production-scale cortical surface acceptance gate using real bilateral brain meshes with explicit provenance and checksum pinning. Contract: validate real GIFTI topology and hemisphere identity; exercise layers, thresholds, slicing/clipping policy, camera orientation, and picking; compare JavaFX and WebGL native rendering against the shared CPU oracle with declared tolerances; capture upload/redraw timings and camera-only no-upload behavior; include adversarial orientation and field-length checks; keep portable renderer logic cross-platform and preserve both JVM/JS verification. Do not vendor data unless its redistribution terms are established.
set.title: Surface viewer production cortical acceptance gate
